critical_code_review_comments: reviews list endpoint uses `account_id: str = Query(default='')` instead of `Optional[str] = Query(None)` like complaints does — technically works (empty string check `if account_id:` filters correctly) but inconsistent style with complaints endpoint. Minor code style concern only, not a functional bug.
returns list endpoint same pattern as reviews — empty string default for account_id. Functionally works.

AccountDetailPage orders fetch uses account_name string match (`/api/marketing/orders?account_name=...`) instead of account_id — this is by design since orders use string-based matching. No bug, just worth noting.

AccountDetailPage: Tab counts (Orders/Komplain/Reviews) all show 0 for TT-LIVE-01 because seeded data was not linked to any specific account_id. Real data will show correctly when added through the UI.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing seeded complaints/reviews/returns (40/40/30 records) are from 'system' seeder and not linked to any account_id, so tabs show 0 for TT-LIVE-01. This is expected behavior.
